intro.text: If you want to become healthier, stronger, more resilient, faster—or simply discover the joy of running—I'd love to help you get there.
intro.bio: I'm a former National Olympic Team athlete, running coach, and lifelong runner with nearly 40 years of experience. I hold a Master's Degree in Athletics Coaching & Physical Education and an international coaching certification.
intro.achievements: I've completed 90 marathons and 300+ half marathons, raced across the United States and Europe, and I'm currently on a mission to run a marathon or half marathon in all 50 U.S. states (20 completed) and finish all World Marathon Majors (5 completed).
intro.personalized: Every training plan I create is personalized—because every runner has a different goal, a different life, and a different journey.
intro.motto: Run for Health. Run for Strength. Run for Life!
intro.mottoSub: Every runner has a goal. Together, we'll make it happen.

story.title: My Story
story.subtitle: From childhood laps to Olympic lanes—and beyond

paragraphs.childhood: As a girl, I started running before I even understood what a marathon was. The rhythm of footsteps became my language—a way to explore, to compete, to dream.
paragraphs.national: That passion led me to the National Olympic Team, where I represented my country from 1990 to 1998. Olympic-level training taught me discipline, resilience, and what it truly means to push beyond limits.
paragraphs.usa: Life brought me to the United States—a new country, new opportunities, and a new chapter. Running came with me, unchanged and unwavering.
paragraphs.career: I built a new career, earned a Master's in Management, and became a software engineer. But the track never left my heart.
paragraphs.it: Technology and athletics may seem worlds apart, yet both demand precision, patience, and continuous improvement—the same qualities that make a great coach.
paragraphs.coach: Today, I combine decades of elite athletic experience with a deep understanding of modern life. I help runners of every level discover their strength—and their joy.
paragraphs.mission: I'm currently on a mission to run a marathon or half marathon in all 50 U.S. states. I've already completed races in 20 states and continue adding new ones every year. Running has also taken me across much of Europe, where I've raced in marathons and half marathons in many different countries.

testimonials.title: SPORT SHAPES CHARACTER
paragraphs: The foundation of my life story was built not only through my career as a professional athlete, my university education, and raising two children born just a year apart, but also through nearly thirteen years of leading organizations in the sports industry.

Those years challenged me in every possible way. I organized international sporting events where every detail mattered. I spoke at conferences and symposiums, learning to listen not only to what was said but also to what remained unspoken. I participated in professional meetings and competitions that constantly tested my ability to make difficult decisions and stand by them. I gave interviews for television, radio, and newspapers, where I learned to balance authenticity with diplomacy.

As a leader, I was responsible for decisions that affected athletes' careers, the success of major events, and the reputation of the organizations I represented. Those responsibilities demanded resilience, integrity, and the ability to stay focused under pressure.
Looking back, I realize that this experience did far more than shape my professional career—it shaped who I am.

It taught me that leadership is not measured by titles or public recognition, but by the willingness to accept responsibility when the outcome is uncertain. That attention to detail is not perfectionism—it is a sign of respect for the people who trust you. And that meaningful change rarely happens through one grand gesture; it is built through countless thoughtful decisions made consistently, with purpose and intention.
These principles continue to guide me today—in sport, in technology, and in every new challenge I choose to embrace.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about coaching with Lena

items.a1: Everyone—from first-time 5K runners to experienced marathoners and ultramarathon aspirants. If you have a goal and commitment, we can work together.
items.a2: You'll receive a personalized training plan, weekly check-ins, and ongoing adjustments based on your progress, schedule, and feedback.
items.q3: How often do plans get updated?
items.a3: Plans are reviewed and adjusted weekly to reflect how you're feeling, your life schedule, and upcoming race goals.
items.a4: Absolutely. Race strategy—including pacing, nutrition, and mental preparation—is a core part of my coaching.
items.a5: Olympic-level experience combined with real-world flexibility. I design training around your life—not the other way around.
